about: ONE fixture, byte-identical in acpx-ui and acpx (P0, brick 7c69df5c). Sources: PERSON-CONTRACT v3.1 C1.6 (ids) and CONCEPTION section 5.2 (handles). Both repos pin this file by sha256 in their person tests; change it only with the programme lead, in both repos at once.
recipe_note: issuer and subject are the exact strings hashed: sha256(issuer + LF + subject), first 20 hex, prefixed p-. N2 is V2 joined by CR LF, so its issuer ends in CR; N3 is V2 with a trailing LF, so its subject ends in LF.

ids.label: V3
ids.how: positive: literal backslashes, as OpenSSL RFC 2253 writes non-ASCII
ids.subject: C=DE,O=NativAI,CN=J\C3\BCrgen M\C3\BCller-\C5\81\C3\B3d\C5\BA

ids.label: N1
ids.how: negative: V2 with issuer and subject swapped
ids.subject: C=DE,O=NativAI,CN=konsiq-dev-ca

ids.label: N2
ids.how: negative: V2 joined by CR LF (the issuer ends in CR)
ids.subject: C=DE,O=NativAI,CN=Daniel Laatz

ids.label: N3
ids.how: negative: V2 with a trailing LF
ids.subject: C=DE,O=NativAI,CN=Daniel Laatz

ids.label: N4
ids.how: negative: V2 in the legacy /C=DE/O=... form
ids.subject: /C=DE/O=NativAI/CN=Daniel Laatz

ids.label: N5
ids.how: negative: V2 in certificate order (Go's form)
ids.subject: CN=Daniel Laatz,O=NativAI,C=DE

ids.label: N6
ids.how: negative: V2's subject under V1's issuer (another person)
ids.subject: C=DE,O=NativAI,CN=Daniel Laatz

ids.label: N7
ids.how: negative: V2 with a space after each comma
ids.subject: C=DE, O=NativAI, CN=Daniel Laatz

not_ids.label: N8
not_ids.how: negative: well-formed lookalikes a reader rejects; it never pads, case-folds or prefix-matches

telegram_actors.label: T1
telegram_actors.how: positive: the K7 actor with a well-formed person_id gives that id (it is stored, not derived)

telegram_actors.label: T2
telegram_actors.how: negative: a telegram actor with no person_id

telegram_actors.label: T3
telegram_actors.how: negative: person_id of the wrong length (prefix, 10 hex)

telegram_actors.label: T4
telegram_actors.how: negative: person_id of the wrong length (one hex too many)

telegram_actors.label: T6
telegram_actors.how: negative: person_id without the p- prefix

telegram_actors.label: T7
telegram_actors.how: negative: person_id with a trailing LF

telegram_actors.label: T8
telegram_actors.how: negative: person_id that is not a string

telegram_actors.label: T9
telegram_actors.how: negative: another channel (web) carrying a person_id

telegram_actors.label: T10
telegram_actors.how: negative: no channel at all, carrying a person_id

telegram_actors.label: T11
telegram_actors.how: negative: the channel name is exact (case differs), carrying a person_id

telegram_actors.label: T12
telegram_actors.how: negative: an agent actor that claims the telegram channel
